headline:
Back above both
moving averages
chart_note: 10-day range: $305.59 - $319.70, up 4.6% over the window - still about 7% below the 52-week high of $344.27.
why_today: Closed up 1.6% today, trading back above both its 50-day ($312) and 200-day ($282.6) averages after a rough late-July pullback from the 52-week high.
pro_1: Quarterly earnings up 28.7% YoY on 16.4% revenue growth - reacceleration after a slower stretch
pro_2: Price now above both key moving averages, with institutional ownership at 66% of shares outstanding
con_1: PEG ratio of 2.54 is rich for Apple's growth rate - the market is pricing in a lot of continued execution
con_2: RSI at 64 is approaching overbought territory after a quick 4.6% run in just 10 days
